climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Riesling, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon fully without cooking off their freshness.
Riesling and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Müller-Thurgau is at its warm limit. It can ripen too fast, giving heavy, soft wine that has lost its freshness.
Gewürztraminer is at its warm limit. It can ripen too fast, giving heavy, soft wine that has lost its freshness.

soil.rock: Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.
